name: web-fashion-store-desktop-collage-with-modal-over-product-and-editorial-poster
title: Store overview: a white 'OFF-WHITE EVERYDAY' page over dimmed screens, and an editorial poster with a hat portrait, product frame and white text card
whatItIs: A top panel shows a bright white desktop page overlaying dimmed pages, with a centred logo and nav, an uppercase title and a mosaic of models in hoodies on pastel backdrops (green, pink, red, mauve, grey). Below is a brown editorial poster of a man in a black cowboy hat with a white-framed product photo of a violet fleece with a Shop Now disc and a white text card 'off-white redefine modern dressing —intellectual.'
whatItMeans: Confident and editorial; the pastel product mosaic contrasts with a moody brand poster.
techniques: Lift one page above dimmed screens.
Give each product its own pastel backdrop.
Pair a poster with a framed product photo.
Use a white text card at the edge.

vocabulary.definition: One screen brightened above dimmed ones.
A collage of photos on different soft backdrops.
A product image inside a white border.
A white block holding a short statement.
